title: Permission console
idea: Permission console: Current access scope, affected people and the proposed change are visible before the control that grants it.
audience: People who need to review permissions within a product-web surface.
worksWellWhen: Authorization changes have consequences users must understand.
avoidWhen: A switch would grant broad access without review.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic signal layout through its review permissions priority and explicit commitment contract: Access changes require server authorization and a confirmed resulting policy.
navigation: Permission console keeps the current review permissions context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Current access scope, affected people and the proposed change are visible before the control that grants it.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to review permissions; authorization changes have consequences users must understand.
composition.priority: Access changes require server authorization and a confirmed resulting policy.

imagery.role: Support the actual review permissions context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Show the resource and principal before controls; use a review route for broad changes.
Preserve entered data and focus when responsive panels become routes.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the permission console structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no review permissions content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Access changes require server authorization and a confirmed resulting policy.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized review permissions content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Access changes require server authorization and a confirmed resulting policy.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active review permissions context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure task interaction latency with representative data and slow network states.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate with browser study renders. Automated browser checks are recorded in evals/specimen-review.json. No independent visual comparison, task study or native runtime verification; remains draft. The illustration/task content demonstrates composition and does not prescribe every linked palette or font.
